philosophy: Make an intangible B2B outcome tangible through one familiar non-human object whose physical transformation is inseparable from the supplied mechanism and brand code.
visual_grammar: short brand-centric copy in the primary scan path
no interface, dashboard, or literal product screenshot
failure_modes: decorative surrealism unrelated to the mechanism
a metaphor that requires explanation before it can be recognized
brand mark appended separately from the visual idea
generated text or logo inside media
too much copy competing with the object
prompt_fragment: Choose one everyday work object already implied by the approved Brief. Give it one physically legible transformation that expresses the supplied outcome. Keep brand, headline, mechanism, offer, and CTA understandable in one fragmented glance.
